node.title: PMA sigma-one carried-layout Top/Post allowance
node.statement: After global profile ownership, first carried source layout partitions every remaining primitive maximal-sunflower codeword into disjoint Top and Post classes. G1 plus K4 gives #Top<=N_top=2((n-k)/2+1)sum_{j=0}^3 binom(k-1,j) at rate half and N_top=0 at lower rates. Thus B_post=n^6-N_top or n^6 is an exact common finite allowance, and #Post<=B_post would imply the complete primitive count is at most n^6. No Post bound or asymptotic allowance is claimed.
